Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
SirTemple wrote:
> Are rumors of Gehenna cummulative?

Each Rumor sets the chosen Methuselahs' number of Master Phase Actions
to two. If more than one Rumor names the same Methuselah, then that
Methuselah will have her number of Master Phase Actions set to two
more than once. It is still set to two, however.
